venue: Saxe Theater at Miracle Mile Shops, Planet Hollywood

zones.label: VIP
zones.description: VIP is the orange seating closest to the stage. Choose it when proximity to the performers matters most.

zones.label: Preferred
zones.description: Preferred is the Vegas Sidekick Sweet Spot. It keeps you in the middle of the room with a centered view and enough distance to take in the choreography across the stage.

zones.label: Standard
zones.description: Standard is the purple seating farther back in the room. It gives you more distance from the stage while keeping the full performance in view.
